name: has_high_qs_ranking_education
description: Checks if the founder has an education with QS ranking less than or equal to 10.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 10 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_executive_experience
description: Checks if the founder has held an executive role (role containing 'CEO', 'President', 'Director', 'VP', 'Managing', or 'Chairman').
expression: lambda founder: any('ceo' in e.get('role', '').lower() or 'president' in e.get('role', '').lower() or 'director' in e.get('role', '').lower() or 'vp' in e.get('role', '').lower() or 'managing' in e.get('role', '').lower() or 'chairman' in e.get('role', '').lower() for e in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: industry_experience_in_target
description: Checks if the founder has work experience in the industry of their startup.
expression: lambda founder: any(founder.get('industry', '').lower() == j.get('industry', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_ipo_event
description: Checks if the founder has IPO events recorded.

name: has_acquisition_event
description: Checks if the founder has acquisition events recorded.

name: has_advanced_degree
description: Checks if the founder holds a PhD or equivalent advanced degree.
expression: lambda founder: any('phd' in e.get('degree', '').lower() or 'doctor' in e.get('degree', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_technical_work_experience
description: Checks if the founder has worked in technical roles such as software engineer, researcher, or developer.
expression: lambda founder: any('software engineer' in j.get('role', '').lower() or 'research' in j.get('role', '').lower() or 'developer' in j.get('role', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_startup_in_target_industry
description: Checks if the founder's startup industry matches any of their previous industries.
expression: lambda founder: founder.get('industry', '').lower() in [j.get('industry', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', [])]

name: has_education_in_top_qs_ranking
description: Checks if the founder's education was obtained from an institution ranked in QS top 50.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 50 for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_experience_in_target_industry
description: Checks if the founder has at least one job in the startup's industry.
expression: lambda founder: any(founder.get('industry', '').lower() == j.get('industry', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_multiple_educations
description: Checks if the founder has more than one educational qualification.

name: has_multiple_industry_experience
description: Checks if the founder has worked in more than one industry.
expression: lambda founder: len(set(j.get('industry', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))) > 1

name: industry_experience_in_n_target
description: Checks if the founder has experience in the target industry, considering industry synonyms.
expression: lambda founder: any(founder.get('industry', '').lower() in [j.get('industry', '').lower()] for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_international_experience
description: Checks if the founder has held roles involving international or global responsibilities.
expression: lambda founder: any('international' in j.get('role', '').lower() or 'global' in j.get('role', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_experience_in_leading_roles
description: Checks if the founder has held leadership roles (e.g., CEO, President, Director).
expression: lambda founder: any('ceo' in j.get('role', '').lower() or 'president' in j.get('role', '').lower() or 'director' in j.get('role', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_education_in_target_field
description: Checks if the founder has education in the field relevant to the startup's industry.
expression: lambda founder: any(e.get('field', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() for e in founder.get('educations', []))

name: has_experience_in_target_field
description: Checks if the founder's previous jobs include roles in the target industry or field.
expression: lambda founder: any(j.get('industry', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() or j.get('role', '').lower() in founder.get('industry', '').lower() for j in founder.get('jobs', []))

name: has_experience_in_high_qs_ranking_institution
description: Checks if the founder studied at an institution ranked in QS top 100.
expression: lambda founder: any(parse_qs(e.get('qs_ranking', '')) <= 100 for e in founder.get('educations', []))
